lines.ja: 九月。梨ヶ坂市・尾根平団地。
lines.en: September. Onehira Housing Complex, Nashigasaka.

lines.ja: 5階の若いの、また遅刻か
lines.en: The kid from the fifth floor, late again?

lines.ja: 五階は家賃が安い。それだけで選んだ
lines.en: Fifth-floor rent is cheap. That's the only reason I picked it.

lines.ja: 空き部屋の、活用……？
lines.en: "Make use of vacant rooms"...?

lines.ja: 空き部屋より、おれの財布を活用してくれ!!
lines.en: Forget the vacant rooms, make use of my wallet!!

lines.ja: 選手村はつくらず、選手は船とコンテナに……
lines.en: No athletes' village will be built. Athletes will stay on ships and in containers...

lines.ja: 選手村を作らずに、船やホテルで泊める大会なのよ
lines.en: It's a Games with no athletes' village. They put everyone up on ships and in hotels instead.

lines.ja: 六百億円、浮いたそうです
lines.en: Apparently that saved sixty billion yen.

lines.ja: 船？ おれの団地なら空き部屋だらけだぞ
lines.en: Ships? My housing complex is full of empty rooms.

lines.ja: テツの団地じゃないでしょ!!
lines.en: It's not your housing complex!!

lines.ja: ここが……何でもやる係、ですか!?
lines.en: This is... the department that does anything?!

lines.ja: カバディの代表チームの、通訳です
lines.en: I'm the interpreter for the kabaddi national team.

lines.ja: ホテルが二重予約で、今夜から泊まれません
lines.en: Our hotel double-booked us, and we can't stay there from tonight.

lines.ja: 窓口では『合宿の担当は出払っています』と……
lines.en: At the counter, they said, "The camp liaison is out."...

lines.ja: 半径三十キロ、空室ゼロです
lines.en: Zero vacancies within thirty kilometers.

lines.ja: 各国の合宿で、全部埋まってる……!!
lines.en: Every other country's training camp has filled everything...!!

lines.ja: カバディって、あの……息止めるやつか
lines.en: Kabaddi? That thing where you hold your breath?

lines.ja: カバディ、カバディ、カバ……ぶはァ!!
lines.en: Kabaddi, kabaddi, kaba... pwaaah!!

lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂市民体育館。
lines.en: Nashigasaka Citizens' Gymnasium.

lines.ja: ユカ、ネル。ダイジョウブ
lines.en: Floor. Sleep. It's okay.

lines.ja: 『母さん、日本は全部ちゃんとしてる』
lines.en: "Mom, everything in Japan is done properly."

lines.ja: ……全然、ちゃんとしてないわよ
lines.en: ...Nothing here is done properly.

lines.ja: 体育館は、夜は閉館……
lines.en: The gym closes at night...

lines.ja: 公民館は、宿泊できない決まり……
lines.en: Community centers aren't allowed to host overnight stays...

lines.ja: 緊急の要綱は、課長の決裁が要るの……
lines.en: The emergency guidelines need the Chief's sign-off...
lines.note: In this story, the city has an emergency rule for opening its facilities to visitors who have nowhere to stay. The rule is made up for the story.

lines.ja: 電源が入っていないか……
lines.en: Switched off, or...

lines.ja: 肝心なときにィ!!
lines.en: Of all the times!!

lines.ja: お金は、払います。いくらでも
lines.en: We will pay. Whatever it costs.

lines.ja: ……いくらでも？
lines.en: ...Whatever it costs?

lines.ja: 一泊三千円、十二人、十四泊……
lines.en: 3,000 yen a night, twelve people, fourteen nights...

lines.ja: 五十万四千円だァ!!
lines.en: That's 504,000 yen!!

lines.ja: 集金と領収書、一割で
lines.en: Collection and receipts. For ten percent.

lines.ja: ちょっと、勝手に……
lines.en: Hey, you can't just decide that...

lines.ja: ……代表チームを救った係……本庁の目に……
lines.en: ...The unit that saved the national team... the head office will notice...

lines.ja: うちの団地に来い!!
lines.en: Come stay at my housing complex!!

lines.ja: 空いてる部屋なら、山ほどある
lines.en: Empty rooms? We've got heaps.

lines.ja: 夜七時。尾根平団地。
lines.en: Seven p.m. Onehira Housing Complex.

lines.ja: 『空き部屋の活用に、ご協力を』……
lines.en: "Please help make use of vacant rooms"...

lines.ja: 公社が『協力しろ』だと!! 空き部屋は使っていい!!
lines.en: The Housing Corporation says "cooperate"!! So I'm allowed to use vacant rooms!!

lines.ja: おれの部屋にも空き部屋はある。物置だけどな
lines.en: I've got a vacant room, too. It's a storeroom, but still.

lines.ja: 但し書き、『宿泊料』でいいですか
lines.en: On the receipt, for "payment for," is "lodging fee" okay?

lines.ja: ホテルみてえで面倒くせえ。布団代と電気代だ
lines.en: Too hotel-ish. Too much hassle. Make it futon fee and electricity.
lines.note: Under the Hotel and Inn Business Act, a lodging fee counts as a lodging fee whatever it is called: bedding, utilities and cleaning charges are included.

lines.ja: ……ホテルじゃないし、そうかしら
lines.en: ...It's not a hotel, so maybe that works?

lines.ja: 僕は九時に帰ります
lines.en: I'm going home at nine.

lines.ja: エ……エレベーターは……？
lines.en: Where's the elevator...?

lines.ja: ねえよ!!
lines.en: There isn't one!!

lines.ja: イイ カイダン。マイニチ、トレーニング
lines.en: Good stairs. Every day, training.

lines.ja: 五階はな、慣れだ
lines.en: The fifth floor is just a matter of getting used to it.

lines.ja: テツ、アリガト
lines.en: Tetsu, thank you.

lines.ja: ……一人、三千円
lines.en: ...Three thousand yen a head.

lines.ja: ……で、おれの寝床は？
lines.en: ...So where do I sleep?

lines.ja: モツ。ダイジョウブ
lines.en: Bag. Okay.

lines.ja: 翌朝。
lines.en: Morning.

lines.ja: 体操、はじめ。いち、に
lines.en: Exercises, begin. One, two.

lines.ja: カバディ、カバディ、カバディ……
lines.en: Kabaddi, kabaddi, kabaddi...

lines.ja: なんだ、それは!?
lines.en: What on earth is that?!

lines.ja: カバディ、カバディ……ぶはっ!!
lines.en: Kabaddi, kabaddi... pwah!!

lines.ja: 膝がね。この一年、下りてないのよ
lines.en: It's my knees. I haven't been downstairs in a year.

lines.ja: イッショ。ユックリ
lines.en: Together. Slowly.

lines.ja: シズさん!? 一年ぶりじゃないの!!
lines.en: Shizu?! You're down here for the first time in a year!!

lines.ja: ……空って、広いのねえ
lines.en: ...The sky is so wide.

lines.ja: 息子もね、あんたくらいの時、走ってたのよ
lines.en: My son was a runner too, at your age, you know.

lines.ja: ……泣いてねえ。客の満足度が上がっただけだ
lines.en: ...I'm not crying. Customer satisfaction just went up.

lines.ja: うちの息子の部屋、空いてるのよ
lines.en: My son's room is empty, you know.

lines.ja: うちも、うちも
lines.en: Ours too, ours too.

lines.ja: ……空き部屋は、団地じゅうにある
lines.en: ...There are vacant rooms all over this complex.

lines.ja: お礼は千円、おれに二千円!!
lines.en: A thousand yen thank-you for them, two thousand for me!!

lines.ja: 『但し、布団代・電気代として』
lines.en: "Payment for: futon and electricity fees."

lines.ja: お礼なんて、いいのよ……
lines.en: Oh, you needn't thank me...

lines.ja: ようこそ、尾根平選手村へ!! 村長のおれだ!!
lines.en: Welcome to Onehira Athletes' Village!! I'm the village chief!!

lines.ja: 一週間後。
lines.en: One week later.

lines.ja: 味噌汁、おかわりあるよ
lines.en: There's more miso soup if you want some.

lines.ja: オカワリ
lines.en: More, please.

lines.ja: 課長には……解決してるし、いいわよね
lines.en: ...It's all solved, so the Chief doesn't need to know, right?

lines.ja: 練習相手のチームが、来られなくなって……
lines.en: The team we were going to practice against can't come...

lines.ja: おれが一点取ったら、宿泊代は倍だ!!
lines.en: If I score even one point, the lodging fee doubles!!

lines.ja: ……主将は『いいよ』と
lines.en: ...The captain says "sure."

lines.ja: 倍なら、僕の一割も倍です
lines.en: If it's double, my ten percent doubles too.

lines.ja: カバディ、カバディ、カバディ……
lines.en: Kabaddi, kabaddi, kabaddi...

lines.ja: 5階の若いの、行けェ!!
lines.en: Go, fifth-floor kid!!

lines.ja: カ……バ……ディ……
lines.en: Ka... ba... di...

lines.ja: 七人タッチ、七点です!!
lines.en: Seven touches. Seven points!!

lines.ja: テツ、ツヨイ
lines.en: Tetsu, strong.

lines.ja: 倍な
lines.en: Double.

lines.ja: ……ハイ
lines.en: ...Yes.

lines.ja: お泊まりですか～、一泊三千円
lines.en: Staying over? 3,000 yen a night.

lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂住宅公社の、巡回の古賀です
lines.en: Koga, Nashigasaka Housing Corporation patrol.

lines.ja: 公社の部屋を、お金を取って貸すのは又貸し
lines.en: Taking money to rent out a Corporation unit is subletting.
lines.note: Renting out a leased public-housing unit to someone else for money is subletting, and the lease usually forbids it. (Here, it is the lease with the fictional Nashigasaka Housing Corporation.)

lines.ja: 契約で、禁止です
lines.en: The contract forbids it.

lines.ja: 掲示に『活用にご協力を』って!!
lines.en: The notice said "please help make use of them"!!

lines.ja: 空き部屋に住んでくださる方を
lines.en: It means: please introduce us to people

lines.ja: 紹介してください、という意味です
lines.en: who would live in the vacant units.

lines.ja: ……追い出されるの？
lines.en: ...Are we going to be thrown out?

lines.ja: お金を取って泊める商売は、旅館業法の許可!!
lines.en: A business that takes money to put people up needs a permit under the Hotel and Inn Business Act!!
lines.note: Running a lodging business for a fee requires a permit from the prefectural governor (or the mayor of a city with a public health center) under the Hotel and Inn Business Act.

lines.ja: 布団代でも電気代でも、宿泊料よ
lines.en: Futon fee, electricity fee, it's all a lodging fee.

lines.ja: 民泊でも届出と、年180日の上限があるの
lines.en: Even minpaku needs a notification, and a cap of 180 days a year.
lines.note: Minpaku (home lodging) is run under the Private Lodging Business Act: file a notification, and operate up to 180 days a year. A tenant must also attach the landlord's written consent to subletting.

lines.ja: 貸主の承諾なしじゃ、住民さんが追い出されるのよ
lines.en: And without the landlord's consent, the residents get evicted!

lines.ja: 布団代は布団代だろォ!!
lines.en: A futon fee is a futon fee!!

lines.ja: 僕の一割、返します
lines.en: I'll return my ten percent.

lines.ja: シズサン、ゴメンナサイ
lines.en: Shizu. Sorry.

lines.ja: 『源田テツ』名義の、領収書だそうだ
lines.en: The receipts are in the name of "Tetsu Genda," it seems.

lines.ja: ――前の日。本庁の廊下。
lines.en: -- The day before. A hallway at the head office.

lines.ja: 皆さまは、梨ヶ坂市の正式なお客様です
lines.en: You are all official guests of Nashigasaka City.

lines.ja: ――そして今。尾根平団地。
lines.en: -- And now. Onehira Housing Complex.

lines.ja: 緊急受け入れ要綱で、地区センターを無料で開けます
lines.en: Under the emergency guidelines, we will open the district center free of charge.
lines.note: Letting guests stay without charging a lodging fee is not a lodging business, so no Hotel and Inn Business Act permit is needed. (The emergency guidelines themselves are made up for the story.)

lines.ja: 皆さまに責任はございません。責任は私にございます
lines.en: None of you is to blame. The responsibility is mine.

lines.ja: ……おれの名前、出てない。セーフ
lines.en: ...My name didn't come up. Safe.

lines.ja: 源田さん
lines.en: Mr. Genda.

lines.ja: さ、さん付け……
lines.en: M-Mister...

lines.ja: 宿泊代は、倍のぶんまで全額お返しを
lines.en: Refund the lodging fees in full, including the doubled amount.

lines.ja: 皆さまへのお礼は、源田さんのお財布から
lines.en: The thank-you money for the residents will come out of Mr. Genda's own wallet.

lines.ja: それと毎朝六時、練習台を。無償で
lines.en: And every morning at six, you will be their practice dummy. Unpaid.

lines.ja: おれの百万がァァ!!
lines.en: My million yen!!

lines.ja: カバディ、カバディ……ぐえっ
lines.en: Kabaddi, kabaddi... guh!

lines.ja: 今朝も、下りてきちゃった
lines.en: Down again this morning.

lines.ja: 公社も、空き部屋を合宿の宿に
lines.en: The Corporation, too,

lines.ja: 正式に貸す検討を始めました
lines.en: has started looking into officially renting vacant rooms as camp lodging.

lines.ja: がんばれェ!!
lines.en: Hang in there!!

lines.ja: シズサン、マタネ
lines.en: Shizu. See you again.

lines.ja: 『母さん、日本は全部ちゃんとしてた』
lines.en: "Mom, everything in Japan was done properly."

lines.ja: 『五階は、遠いけど』……と
lines.en: "...Even if the fifth floor is far," he says.

lines.ja: オネダイラ!!
lines.en: ONEHIRA!!

lines.ja: 宣伝料、取れねえかな……
lines.en: Can't I charge an advertising fee...?

lines.ja: 選手村？ 五階だよ
lines.en: Athletes' village? Fifth floor.

lines.ja: 礼金か!?
lines.en: A reward?!

lines.ja: ……エレベーターは、どちらに？
lines.en: ...Where, may I ask, is the elevator?

lines.ja: ない
lines.en: There isn't one.

lines.ja: 感謝状より、宿泊代くれェ!!
lines.en: Forget the thank-you letter, give me the lodging fees!!
